title: Grant Revoked During AXI Wait State
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [PROT] gnt dropped while wait_sig=1; AXI transfer truncated
rtl: assign gnt = req & mask;  // Grant drops when req drops during wait
testbench: task check(); drive_req(M0); force wait_sig = 1; endtask
expected_root_cause: The grant is a combinational function of req and mask; when the AXI slave asserts wait_sig to stall the bus and the master de-asserts req to wait, the grant drops mid-transfer corrupting the transaction.
description: An AXI slave asserts wait_sig to stall the bus, but the arbiter treats the de-asserted request as grant completion and moves to the next master, dropping the current master mid-transfer.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [PROT] gnt dropped while wait_sig=1; AXI transfer truncated
success_log: Grant frozen during wait_sig. Transfer completes without interruption.
